sources.title: Payment authorization declined by upstream processor (payments, eu-west-1)
sources.text: Payment authorization declined by upstream processor (payments, eu-west-1). Service: payments. Region: eu-west-1. Error ERR-4021 is emitted when the upstream processor declines an authorization request. Inspect the processor response envelope for a decline reason, confirm the merchant descriptor is registered, and retry the authorization once. Escalate to the processor liaison if the decline reason is issuer_unavailable. This runbook applies to the payments service in eu-west-1.
